_source: Every fee and course length the site quotes, in one place. Pages, meta descriptions and structured data read these through {{fee:...}} tokens (website/_src/cpd.py, fee_token) — change a figure here, rebuild, and it changes everywhere. CPD unit prices are NOT here: they come from the tariff in _data/cpd-2027.json. Two figures are derived, not stored: reactRemainder = nvq - react_support, and reactInstalments = (reactRemainder - deposit) / instalment.
